rules.remediation: Document coordinated sampling across the services in the multi-tier system.
rules.sourceContent: MUST NOT sample uniformly across all services in a multi-tier system. A service that fans out to ten downstreams at 100 % sampling will produce ten times the load on those downstreams — sampling SHALL be coordinated.

rules.sourceContent: SHALL NOT rely on tracing in place of structured logging. Traces have a different access path, different retention, different sampling, and different audit posture from logs; they complement, they do not replace.
